message: `idt` with a reset (`assert`) argument other than 0
description: Retired in 2.41.0, which implements the reset: while `assert` is non-zero the output is held at `ic`, and integration restarts from `ic` when it returns to zero (LRM 4.5.4), so this refusal is no longer raised. Codes are never reused. From 2.36.0 to 2.40.x a reset other than a literal 0 was refused with this code, because holding the output while keeping the integral's history needed per-call state the integrator did not have.
actions: Nothing to do on 2.41.0 or later. On 2.36.x-2.40.x, latch the integral at the reset edge and subtract it: `y = idt(x); @(cross(rst - 0.5, +1)) base = y; V(out) <+ ic + y - base;`.
